title: Producer-consumer (bounded buffer)
description: Semaphores empty/full and a mutex; buffer of 2 slots.

input.code:
# Bounded buffer with 2 slots: 3 items are produced and consumed.
# count never goes above 2 or below 0, in any interleaving.
shared count = 0
semaphore empty = 2
semaphore full = 0
mutex m

thread Producer
  MOV i, 3
loop:
  WAIT empty
  LOCK m
  LOAD r, count
  ADD r, 1
  STORE count, r
  PRINT produced
  UNLOCK m
  SIGNAL full
  SUB i, 1
  JNZ i, loop

thread Consumer
  MOV i, 3
loop:
  WAIT full
  LOCK m
  LOAD r, count
  SUB r, 1
  STORE count, r
  PRINT consumed
  UNLOCK m
  SIGNAL empty
  SUB i, 1
  JNZ i, loop
